description.value: The Hampton Inn by Hilton Kamloops is a branded mid-scale hotel located on Rogers Way in Kamloops, a major hub city in BC's interior Thompson River corridor. As part of the global Hampton by Hilton chain, it offers standardized amenities expected of the brand in a city well-positioned for cyclists crossing the province. Kamloops sits at the junction of several major cycling routes, making this a practical overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Hilton.com website returned error pages for all fetched subpages, making the website content effectively unavailable; all amenity fields rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms this is a Hampton Inn by Hilton at 1245 Rogers Way in Kamloops with a Wi-Fi tag (internet_access=wlan), but per methodology, OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration. No cycling-specific amenity evidence is available from either source.
concerns: Website fetch failed for all subpages (Hilton.com returned error pages with reference codes). No amenity data could be confirmed from the website; all optional amenities are null as a result. Contact fields could not be cross-checked.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating branded hotel at a confirmed address in Kamloops; looks_closed=false in OSM. A legitimate overnight option for touring cyclists on the Thompson corridor.
